categories.name: Input data
categories.description: Optional: the capsule is mainly an environment with notebooks. Fill this in to run the annotation/UMAP pipeline as a batch job.

categories.name: Output
categories.description: Leave the default to save a copy in /results (a data asset), or give an s3:// address or local path.

categories.name: Embedding
categories.description: PCA (with harmony given a batch key) or a new scVI model.

categories.name: Neighbors, UMAP & clustering
categories.description: Neighbor graph, UMAP and Leiden clustering.

categories.name: UMAP plots
categories.description: UMAPs saved to /results/umap.png, one panel per name.

parameters.name: Input store
parameters.description: AnnData .zarr, SpatialData .zarr or icechunk repo, e.g. /data/my_asset/sample.zarr. Empty: only prints usage.
parameters.help_text: X must be raw counts in CSR. The input is never changed.

parameters.name: Icechunk branch (optional)
parameters.description: Icechunk only: branch to read and commit on. Empty: main.

parameters.name: SpatialData table (optional)
parameters.description: SpatialData only: table to use, tables/<name>.

parameters.name: Subset column (optional)
parameters.description: obs column to select cells by, e.g. sample_id. Empty: all cells.
parameters.help_text: Cells outside the subset get empty results.

parameters.name: Subset values
parameters.description: Values to keep, comma-separated, e.g. SP0001, SP0002.

parameters.name: Output location (optional)
parameters.description: Leave as is to save a copy in /results (the s3:// value is only an example). A name or /results/... path also saves a copy there. Any other s3:// address or local path is written to directly. S3 needs an AWS secret with write access.
parameters.help_text: Outside /results: a new location is created; an existing zarr must have the same cells and genes and gets the results added (it is changed). An icechunk input must use the address of its own repo. Details: README, Outputs.

parameters.name: Output format (optional)
parameters.description: Empty (auto): same as the input for a copy; for an existing location, what is already there. zarr or icechunk converts a copy, or must match what is there. SpatialData can only be zarr.

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: PCA (harmony with a batch key), or train a new scVI model on the highly variable genes (saved to /results/scvi_model).
parameters.help_text: scVI settings are SCVI_* environment variables or flags; see code/README.md.

parameters.name: Batch key (optional)
parameters.description: obs column(s) with each cell's batch, comma-separated. PCA: harmony. scVI: first is batch, rest covariates. e.g. chip_id
parameters.help_text: Cells with an empty batch make the run fail.

parameters.name: PCA components
parameters.description: PCA only: components computed (neighbors use the first 30).

parameters.name: Leiden resolutions
parameters.description: Comma-separated; higher gives more clusters. Several give one column each. Empty: 1.1. e.g. 0.5, 1.0, 2.0

parameters.name: UMAP name (optional)
parameters.description: obsm key for the UMAP coordinates. Empty: X_umap.

parameters.name: Leiden name (optional)
parameters.description: obs column for the clusters. Empty: leiden. Several resolutions: <name>_<resolution>.

parameters.name: UMAP colors
parameters.description: obs columns to color by, comma-separated; leiden means the clusters. Missing names are skipped. Empty: the default.
